description: June 28 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 1, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a June 28 birthday falls in Cancer, in the first decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a June 28 birthday
paragraphs: Twenty-eight reduces to 1, setting a leader's number beside Cancer's protective instincts on June 28th. Six degrees into the Crab, the Moon's own decan, this birthday is often associated with someone who leads by looking after people, whether a household, a team or a neighbourhood. Moods can be strong, but so is the instinct to take charge in a crisis.

By noon UTC on June 28, the Sun has normally reached roughly 6° of Cancer. That places the date in the Cancer decan that astrologers give to Moon, the first of three. The Moon rules Cancer and also presides over its first decan, so roughly June 22 to July 1 is traditionally the most lunar part of the year. Feeling comes first here, often before words. Natives of this decan are frequently portrayed as protective, intuitive and deeply attached to home, family and memory. Their moods may rise and fall like tides, which is less a flaw than a rhythm worth learning. A doubled Moon can also mean holding on to old hurts longer than they deserve. Giving care to themselves as freely as they give it to everyone else is often the central lesson.

sections.heading: Numerology of the June 28 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 28th reduces as 2 + 8 = 10, then 1 + 0 = 1. The birthday number is 1, but reached by a route that runs through partnership (2) and authority (8). Numerologists often read the 28th as a more cooperative kind of leader than the 1st: independent and ambitious, yet aware that big plans need allies. Those born on this day are frequently described as determined, enterprising and persuasive. As a supporting number, the 28 tends to show in a talent for starting things with others already on board, rather than recruiting help after the fact.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same June 28 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: June 28 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 28 is the 179th day of the year (180th in a leap year). In most years Leo season is under way by July 23, 25 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a June 28 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. June 28 is also the birthday of Jean-Jacques Rousseau (1712), Elon Musk (1971) and Luigi Pirandello (1867).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 28?
faq.answer: June 28 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 28?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 28 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 28th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 28?
faq.answer: By June 28 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 28?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a June 28 birthday are Jean-Jacques Rousseau (1712), Elon Musk (1971) and Luigi Pirandello (1867). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
